adrs.title: ADR-001: Adoption of PostgreSQL Flexible Server for Relational Storage
adrs.context: The project requires ACID-compliant relational transactions with automatic point-in-time recovery.
adrs.decision: Adopt PostgreSQL 16+ on Azure Flexible Server.
adrs.consequences: Ensures standard SQL schema migrations and automated backups.

adrs.title: ADR-002: Service-to-Service Communication Protocol
adrs.context: High-frequency inter-service data exchanges require standard contract definitions.
adrs.decision: Use asynchronous event publishing via Kafka/Event Hubs for loose coupling.
adrs.consequences: Consumers must implement idempotent message processing.

adrs.title: ADR-003: Core Stream Processing Engine Language Selection
adrs.context: Log ingestion throughput requires sub-millisecond latency and zero garbage collection pauses.
adrs.decision: Mandate Rust as the exclusive implementation language for all log collector agents.
adrs.consequences: Highest memory efficiency and safety; all team members must complete Rust training.
